integrity: Mathematical formulas derived explicitly from orthogonal monomial bases and lattice-point asymptotics; no independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: One nonconstant monomial symbol on standard weighted Hilbert Bergman-to-Hardy spaces. General-symbol Weyl coefficients and second terms are not established. The general Schatten membership threshold was already known; only the exact gamma-product counting coefficient, its trace residues, and boundary essential norm are assessed. Historical priority relative to general Toeplitz spectral asymptotics remains a risk. Finite checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: Sharp angular Weyl constants for monomial Bergman-to-Hardy Volterra maps
